trajectory:
User is managing several work tasks and feels occasionally overwhelmed by workload. Tasks: respond to a client email today (urgent/important); prepare for tomorrow’s team meeting; finish and submit a project report by end of week; review/update project plan next week. They prioritized work and self-care.

User practices yoga twice weekly; it helps them relax, focus, feel grounded and centered, especially when anxious. They also meditate to set intentions and focus on daily goals, and want practical mindfulness techniques for busy days. Interests include stress-reducing apps, journaling, and reflection exercises.

User experiences anxiety and depression and is exploring childhood trauma. They already see a therapist and view self-education and reflective practices as complementary, not replacements. Be supportive, trauma-informed, and gentle; avoid encouraging risky trauma excavation. Favor grounding, pacing, self-compassion, emotional regulation, and encourage consulting their therapist when appropriate.
